OTEL_COLLECTOR_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install otel-collector. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

OTEL_COLLECTOR_VERSION.description: Specific version of otel-collector to install.

OTEL_COLLECTOR_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading otel-collector binary or archive artifacts.

OTEL_COLLECTOR_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying otel-collector available remote releases.

OTEL_COLLECTOR_LISTEN_PORT.description: TCP port on which the otel-collector service listens.
